name: The player's Set end time (Bookmarks 1.2.0): the fourth button, between the scissors and Bookmarks; it lists the video's bookmarks, the nearest start before the position first and focused, one that starts later listed but not choosable; Down and Enter choose the next, which is saved with the position as its end (the bookmark read back), the toast offering Make a clip; and the console shows no error or warning from our scripts. As admin, on Long Test Movie; its bookmarks reset first and removed at the end.

steps.name: find Long Test Movie and its runtime
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1, Fields: 'RunTimeTicks' })).Items[0]; return { id: m.Id, runtime: m.RunTimeTicks }; })()

steps.name: reset the movie's bookmarks to 'Set end A' (a point at 0:01), 'Set end R' (the range 0:02-0:03) and 'Set end C' (a point 10 s before the end)
steps.script: const itemId = __vars.movie.id; const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } for (const body of [{ ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 10000000, Name: 'Set end A' }, { ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 20000000, EndTicks: 30000000, Name: 'Set end R' }, { ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: __vars.movie.runtime - 100000000, Name: 'Set end C' }]) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json' }); } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))).map(b => b.Name + ' ' + b.StartTicks + (b.EndTicks ? '-' + b.EndTicks : ''));

steps.name: details page with a Play button
the four player buttons, Set end time between the scissors and Bookmarks
steps.waitFor: (() => { const e = document.querySelector('.videoOsdBottom .buttons .btnBookmarkEnd'); return document.querySelectorAll('.videoOsdBottom .buttons .btnBookmarkAdd, .videoOsdBottom .buttons .btnBookmarkRange, .videoOsdBottom .buttons .btnBookmarkEnd, .videoOsdBottom .buttons .btnBookmarkList').length === 4 && !!e && e.previousElementSibling.classList.contains('btnBookmarkRange') && e.nextElementSibling.classList.contains('btnBookmarkList') && e.getAttribute('title') === 'Set end time' && !!e.querySelector('.material-icons.last_page'); })()

steps.name: the chooser: R (nearest before) focused, then A, then C (later) not choosable
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel')].find(x => /^Set end time to \d+:\d\d$/.test(x.querySelector('h3').textContent)); if (!p) return false; const items = [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-end-item')]; const rows = items.map(i => i.querySelector('.jfbm-end-item-title').textContent + '|' + i.querySelector('.jfbm-end-item-detail').textContent + '|' + i.disabled); if (rows.length !== 3 || document.activeElement !== items[0]) return false; return { heading: p.querySelector('h3').textContent, rows }; })()

steps.name: the rows say the range each would get
steps.assert: /^Set end R\|From 0:02, 0:0\d long \(ends at 0:03 now\)\|false$/.test(__vars.chooser.rows[0]) && /^Set end A\|From 0:01, 0:\d\d long\|false$/.test(__vars.chooser.rows[1]) && /^Set end C\|Starts at \d+:\d\d(:\d\d)?, after this moment\|true$/.test(__vars.chooser.rows[2])
steps.message: the chooser's rows aren't R, A and C with their ranges

steps.name: the chooser closed, the toast says A's end and offers Make a clip
steps.waitFor: !document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop') && [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].some(t => t.textContent === '"Set end A" now ends at ' + __vars.chooser.heading.replace('Set end time to ', '') + '.Make a clip')

steps.name: A read back: a range from 0:01 to the position at the click, the others as they were
steps.eval: (async () => { const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movie.id })); return list.map(b => ({ name: b.Name, start: b.StartTicks, end: b.EndTicks })); })()

steps.name: A ends between 0:05 and 2:00, R still ends at 0:03, C still has no end
steps.assert: (() => { const by = n => __vars.after.find(b => b.name === n); const a = by('Set end A'), r = by('Set end R'), c = by('Set end C'); return a.start === 10000000 && a.end > 50000000 && a.end < 1200000000 && r.end === 30000000 && (c.end === null || c.end === undefined); })()
steps.message: the saved ends aren't what the chooser said

steps.name: mobile: details page with a Play button
mobile: the button row, ours and jellyfin-web's, with where each sits (measured with the controls shown: they hide themselves after a few seconds)
steps.eval: (() => { const osd = document.querySelector('.videoOsdBottom'); const hidden = ['hide', 'videoOsdBottom-hidden'].filter(c => osd.classList.contains(c)); osd.classList.remove(...hidden); const row = [...document.querySelector('.videoOsdBottom .buttons .btnBookmarkEnd').parentElement.children].map(b => { const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return { cls: b.className.split(' ')[0], shown: r.width > 0 && getComputedStyle(b).display !== 'none', left: Math.round(r.left), right: Math.round(r.right), top: Math.round(r.top) }; }).filter(b => b.shown); osd.classList.add(...hidden); return row; })()

steps.name: mobile: our four buttons are inside the 375 px screen
steps.assert: ['btnBookmarkAdd', 'btnBookmarkRange', 'btnBookmarkEnd', 'btnBookmarkList'].every(c => { const b = __vars.mobileRow.find(x => x.cls === c); return !!b && b.left >= 0 && b.right <= 375; })
steps.message: a bookmark button is off the phone's screen (see the button row step)

steps.name: mobile: the chooser
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && /^Set end time to /.test(p.querySelector('h3').textContent) && p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-end-item').length === 3; })()
